title: Instahyre Jobs Search output
description: The jobs found, one row per job in the default dataset (switch between the Jobs, Details and Companies views), plus a run summary record.

jobs.title: Jobs found (jobs)
jobs.description: Every saved job, newest first: title, company, city, experience range, skills, job category, posting date and link, with the company's headcount and founding year, and with details on the description and the company's industry, website, LinkedIn and Glassdoor ratings. Export as JSON, CSV or Excel.

summary.title: Run summary (summary)
summary.description: The OUTPUT record in the default key-value store: how Instahyre was read, how many jobs matched and were saved, checked links, notes about how the input was read, and the settings used.
